# Mars Harness Skills — V5.2 operational methods update

Eleven portable skills turn SaaS-style workflows into a staged mission process: five application packs, four control packs, and two engineering artifact specialists. Each now routes to the bundled [Operational Methods](operational-methods/README.md): ten procedures, ten specialist role contracts, ten JSON templates, eight local checking commands, and synthetic utility tests.

Read the method linked by each skill before execution. The methods cover bounded Tree of Thoughts, graph retrieval/change impact, outline-driven documents, electrical/PCB and mechanical/assembly pairing, simulation and twin readiness, peer challenge, structured handoffs, runtime assurance, and measurement. Tool-dependent capabilities and native integrations remain subject to actual availability, authorization, and validation. See [capability coverage](operational-methods/CAPABILITY_COVERAGE.json).

Recommended sequence: `mars-harness-orchestrator` → `ethical-specialist-agent-network` → appropriate specialist skill(s) → `ground-truth-gatekeeper` → `pm-accelerator-harness` → `mission-memory-steward`.

Each skill is a procedure, not a claim of native platform equivalence. Install or adapt the folder according to the target runtime, map tools explicitly, and preserve approval boundaries.
